trap.label: registro
trap.wrong: I will revert to you tomorrow.
trap.right: I will get back to you tomorrow.
trap.why: Revert, em inglês, é “voltar a um estado anterior” — não responder; o falso cognato vem de “reverter” usado como “retornar”.

opts: go back to a previous state

fix.wrong: I will revert to you soon.
fix.right: I will get back to you soon.

rewrite.prompt: Formal, com “a considerable number of”: “A lot of customers complained.”
rewrite.answer: A considerable number of customers complained.
